o.norm: org.evosuite.runtime.mock.java.lang.MockThrowable: Either opt or longOpt must be specified

i.norm: When {@code getParsedOptionValue(Option, Supplier)} finds no value for the option, it falls back to the supplied default value. Here the default-value supplier is an incompletely configured {@link Option.Builder} whose {@code get()} fails because neither a short nor a long option was specified. {@code CommandLine} wraps that failure in a {@link ParseException}.
An empty command line: it holds no parsed options, so any lookup yields no value.
The option being queried; it is absent from the command line above.
Default-value supplier that is itself broken: building an Option from a builder created with a null option name throws "Either opt or longOpt must be specified".
The supplier's failure is rethrown wrapped as a ParseException.
